entries.title: CHAPS
entries.notes: The CHAPS operator states that the system is usually open Monday-Friday excluding bank or public holidays in England and Wales. This ordinary operating calendar supports the PROJECTED baseline of no additional date-level early closures or exceptions; it is not an exhaustive record of actual operating incidents. Session hours and participant cutoffs are outside this date-only calendar.

entries.title: UK bank holidays
entries.notes: Official dated lists for England and Wales. The implementation transcribes all eight published bank holidays in each of 2026 and 2027, including the Christmas and Boxing Day substitute dates.

entries.title: Extending RTGS and CHAPS settlement hours – next steps towards near 24x7 settlement
entries.notes: Confirms the September 2027 move to a 01:30 weekday opening, which does not change business dates. Sunday and selected bank-holiday settlement remains a consultation proposal for no earlier than 2029; a later 22x6 phase is proposed for no earlier than 2031.
